subject: Error "invalid specification of 'breaks'" when plotting single point with POSIXt

messages.author: c026a1c940a9e142
messages.subject: Error "invalid specification of 'breaks'" when plotting single point with POSIXt
parts:
Hello all,

Anyone know of a fix for the following issue?

Thanks!

 - E

#
# broken.r
#
library("ggplot2")

# In case the dataframe has only _ONE_ point to plot and
# that point has a POSIXt value the plot results in:

# Error in cut.POSIXt(date, time, right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE) : 
#  invalid specification of 'breaks'
#Calls: print ... inherits -> floor_time -> as.POSIXct -> cut -> cut.POSIXt

df <- data.frame(x=c(100), y=c(Sys.time()))

p <- ggplot(df) + aes(x=x, y=y) + geom_point()

p

######

messages.subject: Re: Error "invalid specification of 'breaks'" when plotting single point with POSIXt
parts:
It's fixed in the development version, which does much better at this.

If you want to try it out:

install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
dev_mode() # to avoid interfering with your existing install
install_github("ggplot2", branch = "develop")
library(ggplot2)

Hadley

messages.subject: Re: Error "invalid specification of 'breaks'" when plotting single point with POSIXt
parts:
Hi,

here is a quick workaround with the current version 0.8.9:

df <- data.frame(x=c(100), y=c(Sys.time()))
p <- ggplot(df) + aes(x=x, y=format(y)) + geom_point()
p
